name: Voxel Face Occlusion Culling with Chunk Boundary Wrapping
definition: Computes occlusion status for all 6 faces of every voxel in a chunk, handling neighbor chunks at boundaries.
summary: Voxel Face Occlusion Culling with Chunk Boundary Wrapping determines voxel face visibility by checking neighbor chunks and wrapping coordinates, ensuring correct boundary handling in tiled worlds.
